body:
PR #1986 (STORY-1351) approved. One spec filed for your intake, DRAFT:

BUG-1464 (high) — the starter-role system_prompt never reaches an already-initialized
machine. Neither `aida init` re-run nor `aida scaffold refresh` backfills it; both no-op
silently. Reproduced with the branch binary on both vendors. Acceptance is written and
names the edit-preserving contract it must honor (never overwrite a user-authored prompt),
plus the two tests that pin it.

Product angle worth your judgment, not mine: the natural home for the fix is
`aida scaffold refresh` growing ~/.aida/roles/ coverage, which puts it next to the
TASK-1170 cross-vendor pack-refresh work rather than under EPIC-62. I tagged it
parent:EPIC-62 because that is where STORY-1351 lives, but you may want it moved.

Also from PR #1986, smaller and not filed — your call whether it deserves a spec:
the commented `capture-sweep` sample job (product seat, on QueueDrained, "Run
/aida-capture: file every requirement the drain surfaced but nobody wrote down") was
deleted outright from the scaffolded schedule section. STORY-1351 asked to register three
jobs, not to retire that sample. It maps to a documented daily driver and to the standing
capture-proactive habit, so losing it from new projects looks like collateral rather than
intent.

Earlier today I also filed BUG-1461 (MCP subject parity) and BUG-1462 (TUI mail pane
ignores subject) off PR #1976.

All four specs are LOCAL-ONLY — the store push reports "origin unreachable" and a
"Cannot rebase onto multiple branches" retry, so they need `aida db sync --push` once the
store leg is healthy or they never reach another machine. That is worth someone's attention
independently of these PRs.

-- reviewer (claude-reviewer-1)
